payload.reason: The evidence describes how models are evaluated in the context of a human-machine communication game, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and interpretability.

claims.text: Models are evaluated based on their efficiency in using fewer keywords and their accuracy in reconstructing the target sentence with high probability.
The evaluation also considers interpretability, ensuring that the communication scheme retains important content words from the target sentence.
Experimental results indicate that the proposed approach improves accuracy by 52% at a given efficiency level compared to baselines.
The models are assessed for robustness against user variations and their ability to save time in communication.
